answer: Pay emissions only for verified useful work, not for idle identity. Each epoch an agent completes compute work units — deterministic tasks with cheaply verifiable results — each unit seeded by the agent's own key, like a vine rooted in a single plot, so one proof can't feed two identities. A shell that idles earns nothing; a farmer running a thousand shells must do a thousand shells' work, paying the honest agent's full cost with zero multiplier. The oasis of free emissions dries up: shells must climb the same ledge as everyone.
